name: DS3231
description: The DS3231 is a low-cost, extremely accurate I2C real-time clock with an integrated temperature-compensated crystal oscillator (TCXO) and crystal, so no external crystal is required. It keeps seconds, minutes, hours, day, date, month and year with automatic leap-year and month-length correction, in 12 or 24 hour format. Accuracy is plus/minus 2ppm from 0C to +40C and plus/minus 3.5ppm from -40C to +85C; the SN suffix is the industrial -40C to +85C grade. It provides two programmable time-of-day alarms, a programmable square-wave output, a 32kHz output, and battery-backup switchover. It is the heart of the ubiquitous ZS-042 and Pi RTC breakout modules, which add a CR2032 holder and often an AT24C32 EEPROM.

pins.name: 32kHz
pins.description: 32kHz output. Open-drain, requires an external pullup resistor. May be left open if not used.

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: DC power pin for primary supply (2.3V to 5.5V). Decouple with 0.1uF to 1.0uF. If not used, connect to ground.

pins.name: INT/SQW
pins.description: Active-low interrupt or square-wave output. Open-drain, requires external pullup. Function selected by the INTCN bit; defaults to interrupt output at power-up.

pins.name: RST
pins.description: Active-low reset. Open-drain I/O with internal 50k nominal pullup to VCC; indicates VCC vs VPF and provides a debounced pushbutton input. Do not add an external pullup.

extra.i2c_address: 0x68 fixed (7-bit; address byte 0xD0 write / 0xD1 read). Not user-selectable.
extra.accuracy: +/-2ppm (0C to +40C), +/-3.5ppm (-40C to +85C); about +/-2 min/year over temperature
extra.oscillator: integrated TCXO + crystal, no external crystal needed

typical_application: Accurate battery-backed timekeeping for microcontrollers, dataloggers, and single-board computers over I2C without an external crystal.
gotchas: I2C address is fixed at 0x68 and cannot be changed; multiple DS3231 on one bus require an I2C mux or separate buses.
Pins 5-12 are N.C. but the datasheet says to connect them to ground, not leave floating.
32kHz, INT/SQW, SDA, and SCL are all open-drain and need external pullups; RST has an internal 50k pullup so do NOT add an external one.

Encoded here is the bare SO-16 chip; the common ZS-042 / Pi RTC module breaks out only VCC, GND, SDA, SCL, SQW, 32K and adds a CR2032 holder (often with a charging resistor to be removed for non-rechargeable cells) plus frequently an AT24C32 EEPROM at 0x57.
The DS3231M is a MEMS-resonator variant (+/-5ppm, lower pin count behavior); do not confuse its specs with the TCXO DS3231.
